newsitem.title: USA: Cade sets $26.2 mln in Pratt Canada orders.
newsitem.headline: Cade sets $26.2 mln in Pratt Canada orders.

text.p: Cade Industries Inc on Tuesday said its Auto-Air Composites subsidiary signed a long-term agreement with Pratt & Whitney Canada worth about $26.2 million in new orders over the next 10 years.

Cade's agreement with the unit of United Technologies Corp consists of two five-year pricing contracts. The first runs through 2001 and is estimated at $12.5 million. The second, worth about $13.7 million, covers the years 2002 through 2006.
Of the $26.2 million in new orders, $4 million will be delivered during 1997 and 1998. Those orders are included in the backlog, which now totals $45.4 million.

Pratt & Whitney Canada is a supplier of gas turbine engines used in business jets and regional commuter aircraft. Under the agreement, Cade will make metallic-composite hybrid fan cases for gas turbine engines.
Cade makes high-technology composite components for the aerospace, air transport and specialty industries.
